messages:
harper_marketing: Planning an experiment: add a tiny sparkline on the pricing page that shows cost vs latency tradeoff for three scenarios, plus scenario presets in the mini-calculator. Purpose: help engineering buyers self-identify faster and route high-intent contacts to sales.

josue_growth: Love the sparkline idea. What are the clear success metrics?

harper_marketing: Primary: increase demo-clicks from pricing by +0.9pp in 30 days. Secondary: raise high-intent calculator submissions by 15% and drop FAQ clicks about billing. Also track webinar opt-ins.

sana_product: Scenarios: PoC (low tokens, no SLA), Production-Dev (moderate tokens, batching), Production-Scale (high tokens, KV cache). Sparkline will show estimated latency on x-axis vs cost on y-axis, simple visual.

reid_design: I'll mock three versions: inline sparkline under tiers, a hover micro-chart on result, and an accessible text-only summary for screen readers. Mobile-first.

ivy_eng: Implementation notes: sparkline is calculated client-side from preset multipliers. Events: spark_open, scenario_select, calc_submit, optin_webinar, optin_contract. We'll send webhook only on calc_submit.

leon_sales: Routing ask: if calc_submit && scenario=Production-Scale && contract_optin checked -> create SFDC lead with tag=pricing_scale, lead_score=75, note:"sparkline-selected:Production-Scale". Also include est_monthly_usd, est_latency_ms, utm. Ping #ae-inbox.

mira_cs: I'll prepare FAQ microcopy (two lines) to sit beside the sparkline: billing cadence and cancellation terms, plus quick reply templates for incoming chats. Keep it short.

josue_growth: A/B testing plan? single variant or multi-arm?

harper_marketing: Multi-arm A/B test: control (current page), varA (sparkline + scenario presets + calc), varB (sparkline + calc + inline micro-FAQ + webinar opt-in). 40/30/30 split to get a bit more signal for the main variant. Run 4 weeks or until 8k pricing visits. Primary KPI: demo_CTR. Secondary: calc_submit_rate, high-intent leads to SQL.

sana_product: FAQ Q->A format examples: 
Q: How does reserved capacity billing work?
A: Commit length options: monthly or annual. Billing monthly in arrears. 30-day notice to cancel.

reid_design: Sparkline microcopy draft: "This illustrative chart shows how batching and KV cache reduce latency and lower per-token cost as volume grows. Estimates exclude egress and private infra fees."

ivy_eng: Webhook payload example: {"lead_source":"pricing_sparkline","scenario":"Production-Scale","est_monthly_usd":"...","est_latency_ms":"...","priority":"high","utm_source":"..."}. Will implement retries x3 + DLQ.

leon_sales: Also add a checkbox: "We have an RFP / procurement timeline" -> if checked, set lead_reason=rfp and higher priority. We want to catch procurement cycles.

mira_cs: For support, two quick replies: 1) short billing summary + link to enterprise page; 2) how to request private deployment + contact AE. Will draft and share.

orion_deploybot: Reminder: Experiment "pricing-sparkline-scenarios" scheduled for 2027-01-10 09:00 UTC. CI window reserved 07:00-09:00 UTC. :rocket:

harper_marketing: Action items: reid designs, sana define scenario multipliers + copy, ivy implement calc + events + webhook, josue set tracking and Looker slice, leon map SFDC + AE alerts, mira support replies. Smoke test 24h before launch. :thumbsup:
